critical_bugs: Uncaught exceptions possible from pickle.load() if fused_data.pkl is corrupted, truncated, or contains unexpected schema versions
Potential KeyError/IndexError when accessing registry.entities[entity_id]['canonical_name'] and position coordinates p[0]/p[1] without explicit bounds/key validation
warnings: pickle deserialization of session data poses arbitrary code execution risk if fused_data.pkl originates from untrusted or tampered sources
sys.path.insert(0, ...) permanently mutates global interpreter state, which can cause import shadowing and conflicts in long-running robot control loops
CLI arguments session_path and root_path lack validation/sanitization, risking unintended file reads/writes outside expected workspace directories
recommendations: Replace pickle with a safer serialization format like JSON, MessagePack, or HDF5 for both reading fused data and writing match reports
Wrap pickle.load() and all dictionary/list indexing operations in try/except blocks with structured logging and graceful degradation
Validate and resolve CLI paths using pathlib.Path.resolve(), then verify they reside within a predefined safe base directory before I/O operations
Remove sys.path manipulation; use proper Python packaging, virtual environments, or importlib.util.spec_from_file_location for dynamic imports
